{{Top|leg}}
The '''pulley bow''' was a [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyan]] compound bow, and used a set of pulleys to augment a user's natural strength. In the hands of a Sakiyan, the pulley bow was a powerful weapon; most other races could barely pull the [[Arrow/Legends|arrow]] into the ready position.<ref name="MedStar I: Battle Surgeons">''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''</ref>
